name: Wand of Fireballs
description: A wand of red wood capped with a bead of glowing amber.
body:
## What it does

Point it and speak, and a bead of flame streaks out to burst as a fireball. Spend more charges for a greater blast.

## Charges

It holds seven and regains 1d6 + 1 each dawn. Spend the last and it may crumble to ash.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.note: each further charge raises its level by one, up to 3 charges

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash
